test.description: Run the project's test suite (cargo test + vitest).
test.prompt: Run the project's test suite. For Rust: `cargo test --workspace`. For frontend: `pnpm vitest run`. Report any failures with file paths and a one-line summary of each.

lint.prompt: Run `cargo clippy --fix --allow-dirty --allow-staged` in `src-tauri/` and `pnpm eslint --fix` in the frontend. Report any remaining issues that could not be auto-fixed.

dev.prompt: Run `pnpm tauri dev` from the project root and stream the output. If the dev server is already running, say so instead of starting a second instance.

build.prompt: Run `pnpm tauri build` from the project root. Stream the output and report the path of the produced binary on success.

index-rebuild.description: Force-rebuild the SQLite index from scratch.
index-rebuild.prompt: Delete the vault's index file (locate it from the active vault path in `settings.json`, fall back to `<vault>/.obsidiana/index.db`), then re-open the vault so the Rust backend rebuilds the index. Report success and the new `index_status` IPC response.
